details:
Mission Control: Beyond Earth

Mission Control: Beyond Earth is an interactive educational space mission design and simulation game developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

What does the project do?

The project transforms the complex process of space mission planning into an engaging, interactive experience. Players take the role of a Space Mission Director and make important decisions involved in designing, planning and managing a space mission.

Players can explore different mission destinations, customize spacecraft, select scientific instruments and launch vehicles, and manage essential engineering resources such as mass, power, fuel, communication and budget.

How does it address the challenge?

Designing a space mission involves balancing multiple engineering requirements. Students often find these concepts difficult to understand through theoretical learning alone.

Our game provides an interactive environment where players can experiment with engineering decisions and understand how different choices influence mission performance, resource availability and overall mission success.

Intended impact

The project aims to make aerospace engineering and space exploration more accessible to students. It encourages scientific curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving and engineering decision-making through interactive learning.

Technology and development

The application was developed using Google AI Studio as part of our development workflow. Its development specifications include interactive web technologies, spacecraft engineering calculations, mission simulation and resource management. The implementation focuses on connecting player decisions with mission outcomes.

Creativity and innovation

The key innovation is combining space mission planning, engineering trade-offs and game-based learning in one interactive experience. Instead of simply learning about spacecraft systems, players experience the challenges of making decisions as a mission director.

Our vision is to turn complex aerospace engineering concepts into an accessible and engaging learning experience for the next generation of space explorers.
